from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """A single document from the collection, recording its own title and which other papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the current paper being processed")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of other provided papers explicitly referenced in this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitation]
